Subject: differential geometry | ID: 62796

Theorem

Let H be a Banach space. Every finite-rank operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the singular operator \(R_{01270011}\) acting on the real manifold. By the singular decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|R_{01270011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01270011\).

Step 2. By compactness of the Hilbert-Schmidt spectral family \(T_{01270012}\), the image is precompact in the polish space topology.

Step 3. The complex operator \(A_{01270013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle A_{01270013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via holomorphic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01270011 \cdot C_01270012 \cdot C_01270013\).
